capabilities.supported_domain: Coaxial cylindrical through/blind drilling and opposed counterbores in the counterbored_fixture recipe: counterbore radius 6..8 mm, depth 4..8 mm, plate height 18..24 mm; native parameter sweep and independently imported assembly exchange at default/min/max configurations.
exclusions: Noncoaxial intersecting bores
Conical countersinks and general pockets
Threads, fit, preload and load capacity certification
General commercial CAD parity

capabilities.supported_domain: Native annular stock with three blind spacer sockets and six counterbored mounting holes; mirrored bearing cartridge at bolt_pitch 40..44 mm, seat_depth 4..8 mm, flange_height 18..24 mm. Native 27-case sweep and independent default/min/max exchange checks.
exclusions: General intersecting holes and pockets
Conical countersinks
Threads, fits, loads and bearing performance certification
Manufacturing drawing release

capabilities.supported_domain: Native annular covers with six conical countersinks composed with through bores and three blind locating sockets; mirrored cover assembly at bolt_pitch 40..44 mm, seat_depth 2..4 mm, flange_height 18..24 mm. Sixteen direct box/disk/annulus and interior cone/pilot crossing cases cover top/bottom and common oblique frames, with 45-degree and non-45-degree cone angles.
exclusions: General intersecting holes and pockets
Conical apex machining and enclosed cutters
Threads, fits, fastener preload and bearing performance certification
Manufacturing drawing release

capabilities.supported_domain: Native directed line/circular-arc plane sections of supported planar solids and axis-transverse analytic bodies, with area/centroid and face provenance. Source-bound CLI body and rigid-assembly queries, separate occurrence paths, and true-mm SVG. Independent imported STEP intersections cover countersunk cover depths, common rigid frames, a planar oblique cut, empty space and a small countersink.
exclusions: Oblique intersections of curved surfaces; ellipses and hyperbolas
Tangent, coplanar or unresolved topology-event planes
Material union of overlapping assembly occurrences
Associative dimensions, hidden-line drawings, fits and GD&T certification
